title: Afterlife with Archie #8 Archie Horror July 2015 Francesco Francavilla Cover
conditionDescription: Cover clean with no tears; light wear along the spine. See photos.
descriptionText:
Afterlife with Archie #8 (July 2015), Archie Horror / Archie Comics. Written by Roberto Aguirre-Sacasa (Riverdale, Chilling Adventures of Sabrina), art and cover by Eisner winner Francesco Francavilla. Direct edition, $3.99 cover price.

The Riverdale survivors wait out a snowstorm in a hotel while Mary Andrews reveals the town's darkest secret.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
